transcript: My friend, the universe is patient. It will place you in the same situations again and again, not to punish you, but to teach you until you learn to respond differently, until you learn to think differently, until you finally see that enough is enough. What repeats in your life is not coincidence. It is a lesson asking to be completed. Remember this, old habits do not open new doors. You cannot step into a new chapter while carrying the same weight from the last one. Growth requires release. Not everything is meant to come with you. Eliminate what drains you. Create space for what strengthens you. This is how evolution begins.
